title: 放射科医生兼职教AI：教完就担心，自己会不会被取代
speaker: Morgan Meager

segments.en: What's interesting here, though, is that they're using these experts to try to help them. But at some point, is it going to move past helping and start replacing the very experts who were training this?
segments.zh: 有趣的是，他们利用这些专家来帮忙。但某一天，这是否会超越帮忙，开始取代那些训练AI的专家本身？

segments.en: I mean, I have a friend who used to do a lot of writing, she did script writing, she did comedy writing, and she has one of these jobs. She loves it. It's flexible. She just had a baby. She works from home.
segments.zh: 我有个朋友以前写很多剧本和喜剧，现在做这类工作。她很喜欢，时间灵活，刚生了孩子，在家工作。

segments.en: But it keeps saying to her, like, aren't you eventually putting yourself out of a job? Yeah. And I think that is a really big concern and people feel like this shift from kind of these more generalist tasks to these specialist tasks.
segments.zh: 但总有人问她：你最终会不会让自己失业？我认为这是一个很大的担忧，人们觉得这是从通才任务向专家任务的转变。

segments.en: People have worried this signifies AI models essentially absorbing larger amounts of human knowledge.
segments.zh: 人们担心这标志着AI模型本质上在吸收大量人类知识。

segments.en: And we've seen lots of predictions that AI models are going to make a lot of knowledge workers, people whose value rests on their expertise, they're going to push them out of the labor market.
segments.zh: 我们看到许多预测称，AI模型将让许多知识工作者——那些价值基于专业知识的人——被挤出劳动力市场。

segments.en: And we're not seeing that yet. But I think what's interesting is you kind of have these kind of two levels. So you have the expert workers. And then, but you still have kind of generalist data workers earning much lower wages.
segments.zh: 目前尚未看到这种情况。但有趣的是存在两个层级：专家工作者，以及收入低得多的通才数据工作者。

segments.en: They haven't disappeared. They're still there. But their work is also shifting. So I spoke to someone, Brooke Hansen, when she started, she started kind of decade ago doing this work. It was very easy.
segments.zh: 他们并未消失，仍然存在，但工作也在变化。我采访了布鲁克·汉森，她大约十年前开始做这类工作，当时很容易。

segments.en: She could do it when she was looking after her babies as a stay-at-home mum and just kind of quickly do it. But now it's changed in a way where it demands a lot more deep and focused work.
segments.zh: 她作为全职妈妈照顾孩子时就能快速完成。但现在变了，需要更深入、更专注的工作。

segments.en: And I think that's interesting that we have these kind of two levels running parallel to each other. And it's kind of like the data work industry is widening and absorbing.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，这两个层级并行运行。数据工作行业正在扩大和吸收。

segments.en: And we don't yet know what the consequences of that are going to be on the labor market. But people are worried that it's going to warp the labor market in interesting ways.
segments.zh: 我们尚不知道这对劳动力市场的影响。但人们担心它会以有趣的方式扭曲劳动力市场。
